players.name: Dimitar Berbatov
players.note: Frozen out behind Rooney, Hernández and Welbeck for five starts, still scoring seven goals in them; the touch was intact, a step down from the Golden Boot year.

players.name: Jonny Evans
players.note: His most complete United season: first-choice alongside Ferdinand while Vidić was out injured, and far more assured on the ball than before.

players.name: Rio Ferdinand
players.note: Fitter again, with twenty-nine starts, and playing deeper to make up for the pace that had gone; he still read the game very well, but was no longer the defender of the 2007/08 anchor.

players.name: Darren Fletcher
players.note: Ulcerative colitis ended his season in late November; seven starts, and already short of the engine that made 2009/10.

players.name: David de Gea
players.note: Twenty and shaky under crosses early on, but his reflexes were already elite and he had settled by spring.

players.name: Javier Hernández
players.note: A concussion in pre-season and a smaller role once Rooney and Welbeck were the first pair; he still finished just as well, but was slightly less of a factor than in his first year.

players.name: Phil Jones
players.note: He started superbly at nineteen, at right-back, centre-back and in midfield. Injuries and a loss of form slowed the second half of his season.

players.name: Wayne Rooney
players.note: Twenty-seven league goals, second only to van Persie, and back to his best after the uneven 2010/11; a rung below the 2009/10 peak, which had the same output with more all-round authority.

players.name: Paul Scholes
players.note: Came out of retirement in January and went straight back to controlling games from deep; still a superb passer at thirty-six, but rated a touch below the season before, not above it.

players.name: Antonio Valencia
players.note: Back from the ankle fracture to have his best season: 13 league assists, and United's players voted him their player of the year.

players.name: Nemanja Vidić
players.note: Six starts before a cruciate ligament injury in December ended his season; he was rated on those months, slightly below the year before.

players.name: Danny Welbeck
players.note: Breakthrough year: back from Sunderland and starting up front for the runners-up, with nine goals, the link play to go with them and a first England cap. Still short of a clinical finisher.
